The number of bedrooms, used to search for listings matching this criteria. Use `0` to indicate a studio layout. Supports [numeric ranges](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-numeric-range-parameters) and [multiple values](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-multiple-value-parameters)

The total living area size in square feet, used to search for listings matching this criteria. The total lot size in square feet, used to search for listings matching this criteria. Supports [numeric ranges](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-numeric-range-parameters) and [multiple values](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-multiple-value-parameters)

The year of construction, used to search for listings matching this criteria. Supports [numeric ranges](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-numeric-range-parameters) and [multiple values](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-multiple-value-parameters)

The current listing status, used to search for listings matching this criteria. See [explanation of listing statuses](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/property-listings-schema#listing-status-field-values)

The listed price of the property, used to search for listings matching this criteria. Supports [numeric ranges](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-numeric-range-parameters) and [multiple values](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-multiple-value-parameters)
The number of days since a property was listed on the market, with a minimum of 1. Supports [numeric ranges](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/search-queries#using-numeric-range-parameters)
The maximum number of listing records to return, between 1 and 500. Defaults to `50` if not provided. [Learn more](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/pagination) about pagination

The index of the first listing record to return, used to paginate through large lists of results. Defaults to `0` if not provided. [Learn more](https://developers.rentcast.io/reference/pagination) about pagination
When enabled, will return the total number of results matching the current query in the `X-Total-Count` response header. Defaults to `false` if not provided
